description: Single-check mutants of the checks that the E01-02.pins driver adds for the fast-node profile of D108: the accepted path store, the retention of pruned homes and the effective values of the accepted flags.

mutants.name: accepted homes: any
mutants.original: require(all(preflight[case] == "<nil>" for case in PREFLIGHT_ACCEPTED)

mutants.name: scheme of the accepted path store
mutants.original: require(preflight["path_initialized_scheme"] == "path" and

mutants.name: profile of the accepted path store
mutants.original: preflight["path_initialized_profile"] == profile_digest(family, "path"),

mutants.name: home at the floor
mutants.original: require(preflight["pruned_store_at_floor"] == "<nil>" and

mutants.name: home below the floor
mutants.original: preflight["pruned_store_below_floor"].startswith("forbidden pruning profile"),

mutants.name: coverage: oldest block
mutants.original: "oldest": PRUNED_AT_FLOOR,

mutants.name: coverage: head
mutants.original: "head": floor + PRUNED_AT_FLOOR, "floor": floor}

mutants.name: coverage: floor
mutants.original: "head": floor + PRUNED_AT_FLOOR, "floor": floor}

mutants.name: legacy offset is not refused
mutants.original: require(retention_refusal(named[("TestNativeLegacyPruneOffset", "legacy_offset")], 5, 0, floor),

mutants.name: offset at the floor is refused
mutants.original: require(offset["offset N blocks behind the head"] == "<nil>" and

mutants.name: offset closer than N is accepted
mutants.original: retention_refusal(offset["offset N-1 blocks behind the head"], 3, floor + 2, floor) and

mutants.name: offset on a home without a head is accepted
mutants.original: retention_refusal(offset["offset on a genesis-only home"], 5, 0, floor),

mutants.name: ancient tail: coverage
mutants.original: {"oldest": ANCIENT_TAIL, "head": floor + ANCIENT_TAIL,

mutants.name: ancient tail closer than N is accepted
mutants.original:
retention_refusal(tail["ancient tail N-1 blocks behind the head"], ANCIENT_TAIL,
                                  floor + ANCIENT_TAIL - 1, floor),

mutants.name: client without block pruning keeps pruned homes
mutants.original:
require("pruned_store_at_floor" not in preflight and "pruned_store_below_floor" not in preflight,
                f"{family} has no pruned homes to check")

mutants.name: effective values: any
mutants.original: require(all(reported.get(field) == value for field, value in values.items()),
mutants.replacement: require(any(reported.get(field) == value for field, value in values.items()),

mutants.name: retention refusal needs no text
mutants.original: return (isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("forbidden pruning profile") and f"from {oldest}," in value and
mutants.replacement: return (True and value.startswith("forbidden pruning profile") and f"from {oldest}," in value and

mutants.name: retention refusal needs no prefix
mutants.original: return (isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("forbidden pruning profile") and f"from {oldest}," in value and
mutants.replacement: return (isinstance(value, str) and True and f"from {oldest}," in value and

mutants.name: retention refusal needs no oldest block
mutants.original: return (isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("forbidden pruning profile") and f"from {oldest}," in value and
mutants.replacement: return (isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("forbidden pruning profile") and True and

mutants.name: retention refusal needs no head
mutants.original: f"head {head}," in value and f"fewer than {floor} " in value)
mutants.replacement: True and f"fewer than {floor} " in value)

mutants.name: retention refusal needs no floor
mutants.original: f"head {head}," in value and f"fewer than {floor} " in value)
